title: sonde check --init -f json
description: The `sonde.toml` written from a run, and the CI step that holds every run to it.

maxRequests.description: `[check] max-requests`: the run's requests with `--tolerance` of room.

findings.description: `[check.findings]`: each of the run's findings by identity, with its count, but those in `notKnown`. A run with another, or more of one, fails `check`.

notKnown.description: The run's findings that are a fault in what the program does (a read written back, `obs.rmw`): never written as known, so `check` fails until each is fixed.

command.description: The program's command, as the run recorded it: the step's `run`.

runArgs.description: The step's `run-args`: the store as the run was told it (`--demo`, `-e NAME`, `--url URL`). Absent for a run of no endpoint.

uses.description: The action at this sonde's major version (`hxddh/sonde@v29`).
